name: activity-feed
title: Activity Feed
description: A record's history, Linear style: comment threads and activity events ("Priya changed status from Open to Done · 2h") in one list, with an All / Comments / Activity filter, an order toggle, collapsible event groups, a New divider, a floating Jump to latest, J/K/X keyboard navigation and a skeleton.

meta.whenToUse: A record's history on its page (a task, a deal, a document): what changed, who changed it and when, interleaved with the comment threads.
meta.whenNotToUse: Comments alone (Comments), a cross-record notification list (Inbox), or a dated milestone list (Timeline).
